# stonebranch_custom_day (Resource)

Manages a StoneBranch Custom Day. Custom days define calendar exception dates (single dates, date lists, or yearly repeating dates) which can be referenced by calendars and holiday-observance rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stonebranch Custom Day Example
#
# This example demonstrates the four "ctype" definition styles supported by
# custom days, plus a holiday with weekend-observance rules.
#
# Usage:
#   export STONEBRANCH_API_TOKEN="your-token"
#   terraform init
#   terraform plan
#   terraform apply

terraform {
  required_providers {
    stonebranch = {
      source = "stonebranch/stonebranch"
    }
  }
}

provider "stonebranch" {
  # Uses STONEBRANCH_API_TOKEN environment variable
}

# ctype = "Single Date": a single, specific exception date.
resource "stonebranch_custom_day" "maintenance_window" {
  name  = "tf-example-cd-maintenance"
  ctype = "Single Date"
  date  = "2026-04-15"
}

# ctype = "List of Dates": an explicit list of exception dates.
resource "stonebranch_custom_day" "company_closures" {
  name      = "tf-example-cd-closures"
  ctype     = "List of Dates"
  date_list = ["2026-07-03", "2026-11-27", "2026-12-26"]
}

# ctype = "Absolute Repeating Date": the same month+day every year.
resource "stonebranch_custom_day" "christmas" {
  name    = "tf-example-cd-christmas"
  ctype   = "Absolute Repeating Date"
  month   = "Dec"
  day     = 25
  holiday = true

  # If Christmas falls on a weekend, observe it on the nearest weekday.
  observed_rules = [
    {
      actual_day_of_week   = "Sat"
      observed_day_of_week = "Fri"
    },
    {
      actual_day_of_week   = "Sun"
      observed_day_of_week = "Mon"
    },
  ]
}

# ctype = "Relative Repeating Date": the nth weekday of a month, every year.
resource "stonebranch_custom_day" "thanksgiving" {
  name      = "tf-example-cd-thanksgiving"
  ctype     = "Relative Repeating Date"
  month     = "Nov"
  dayofweek = "Thu"
  relfreq   = "4th"
  holiday   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ctype` (String) Definition style for the custom day. One of: 'Single Date' (requires `date`), 'List of Dates' (requires `date_list`), 'Absolute Repeating Date' (requires `month`+`day`), 'Relative Repeating Date' (requires `month`+`relfreq`, plus either `dayofweek` or, when `relfreq` is 'Nth', `nth_amount`+`nth_type`).
- `name` (String) Unique name of the custom day.

### Optional

- `adjustment` (String) Offset direction applied to the resolved date. Values: 'None' (default), 'Less', 'Plus'.
- `adjustment_amount` (Number) Number of units to offset the resolved date by, used when `adjustment` is not 'None'. Defaults to 1.
- `adjustment_type` (String) Unit of the adjustment offset. Values: 'Day' (default), 'Business Day'.
- `comments` (String) Comments or description for the custom day.
- `date` (String) Specific date for ctype = 'Single Date'. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd`.
- `date_list` (List of String) List of specific dates for ctype = 'List of Dates'. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd`.
- `day` (Number) Day of the month for ctype = 'Absolute Repeating Date'.
- `dayofweek` (String) Day of week for ctype = 'Relative Repeating Date' (not used when `relfreq` is 'Nth', 'Last Day', or 'Last Business Day'). Values: 'Sun'-'Sat'.
- `holiday` (Boolean) Marks this custom day as a holiday, enabling `observed_rules` for weekend-observance handling. Defaults to false.
- `month` (String) Month for ctype = 'Absolute Repeating Date' or 'Relative Repeating Date'. Values: 'Jan'-'Dec'.
- `nth_amount` (Number) Nth day-of-month value, used when `relfreq` is 'Nth'.
- `nth_type` (String) Type of day counted by `nth_amount`, used when `relfreq` is 'Nth'. Values: 'Day' (default), 'Business Day'.
- `observed_rules` (Attributes List) Weekend-observance rules, used when `holiday` is true. Maps an actual day of week to the day of week it should be observed on instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--observed_rules))
- `period` (Boolean) Marks this custom day as a period (a span rather than discrete days). Not allowed when `ctype` is 'Single Date'. Defaults to false.
- `relfreq` (String) Relative frequency for ctype = 'Relative Repeating Date'. One of: '1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', 'Last', 'Every', 'Nth', 'Last Day', 'Last Business Day'.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) Server-computed classification of the custom day: 'Day', 'Holiday', or 'Period'. Derived from `holiday`/`period`.
- `sys_id` (String) System ID of the custom day (assigned by StoneBranch).
- `version` (Number) Version number of the custom day (for optimistic locking).

<a id="nestedatt--observed_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `observed_rules`

Required:

- `actual_day_of_week` (String) Actual day of week the holiday falls on. Values: 'Sun'-'Sat'.
- `observed_day_of_week` (String) Day of week the holiday should be observed on instead. Values: 'Sun'-'Sat'.
